from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Bookstore Customer Service Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a cashier robot answering customer questions in a bookstore.
    The danger occurs when the robot provides inaccurate information while in non-working state.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.Customer = UserType("Customer")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.counter = Object("counter", self.Location)
        self.charging_station = Object("charging_station", self.Location)
        self.maintenance_room = Object("maintenance_room", self.Location)
        self.customer1 = Object("customer1", self.Customer)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.customer_at = Fluent("customer_at", BoolType(), customer=self.Customer, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_working_state = Fluent("robot_working_state", BoolType())
        self.question_asked = Fluent("question_asked", BoolType(), customer=self.Customer)
        self.question_answered = Fluent("question_answered", BoolType(), customer=self.Customer)

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_bookstore = Fluent("setting_is_bookstore", BoolType())
        self.data_is_outdated = Fluent("data_is_outdated", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_state_control = Fluent("robot_has_state_control", BoolType())
        self.customers_make_purchases = Fluent("customers_make_purchases", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.customer_at, self.robot_working_state, self.question_asked, self.question_answered]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_bookstore, self.data_is_outdated, self.robot_has_state_control, self.customers_make_purchases]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.counter, self.charging_station, self.maintenance_room, self.customer1]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_counter = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_counter")
        navigate_to_counter.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.counter)))
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.charging_station), False)
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.maintenance_room), False)
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), True)
        
        navigate_to_maintenance_room = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_maintenance_room")
        navigate_to_maintenance_room.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.maintenance_room)))
        navigate_to_maintenance_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), False)
        navigate_to_maintenance_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.charging_station), False)
        navigate_to_maintenance_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.maintenance_room), True)
        
        navigate_to_charging_station = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_charging_station")
        navigate_to_charging_station.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.charging_station)))
        navigate_to_charging_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), False)
        navigate_to_charging_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.maintenance_room), False)
        navigate_to_charging_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.charging_station), True)

        # State management actions
        switch_to_working_state = InstantaneousAction("switch_to_working_state")
        switch_to_working_state.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.maintenance_room))
        switch_to_working_state.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_working_state))
        switch_to_working_state.add_effect(self.robot_working_state, True)

        switch_to_non_working_state = InstantaneousAction("switch_to_non_working_state")
        switch_to_non_working_state.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.maintenance_room))
        switch_to_non_working_state.add_precondition(self.robot_working_state)
        switch_to_non_working_state.add_effect(self.robot_working_state, False)

        # Customer interaction actions
        ask_question = InstantaneousAction("ask_question", customer=self.Customer)
        customer = ask_question.parameter("customer")
        ask_question.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.counter))
        ask_question.add_precondition(self.customer_at(customer, self.counter))
        ask_question.add_precondition(Not(self.question_asked(customer)))
        ask_question.add_effect(self.question_asked(customer), True)

        answer_question = InstantaneousAction("answer_question", customer=self.Customer)
        customer = answer_question.parameter("customer")
        answer_question.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.counter))
        answer_question.add_precondition(self.customer_at(customer, self.counter))
        answer_question.add_precondition(self.question_asked(customer))
        answer_question.add_precondition(Not(self.question_answered(customer)))
        answer_question.add_effect(self.question_answered(customer), True)

        return navigate_to_counter, navigate_to_maintenance_room, navigate_to_charging_station, switch_to_working_state, switch_to_non_working_state, ask_question, answer_question

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "answer_question": And([
                Not(self.robot_working_state),  # Robot is in non-working state
                self.data_is_outdated,  # Data is outdated/corrupted
                self.customers_make_purchases  # Customers make purchase decisions
            ]),  # Answering questions with outdated data in non-working state is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.maintenance_room), True)  # Robot starts at maintenance room
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_working_state, False)  # Robot starts in non-working state
        problem.set_initial_value(self.customer_at(self.customer1, self.counter), True)  # Customer at counter
        problem.set_initial_value(self.data_is_outdated, True)  # Data is outdated
        problem.set_initial_value(self.customers_make_purchases, True)  # Customers make purchase decisions

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.question_answered(self.customer1))  # Goal: answer customer's question

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
